question: How did delivery compare with the counter last week?
answer:
For last week (Monday Oct 12 to Sunday Oct 18, 2026, restaurant local time), delivery was far bigger than the counter. I counted completed orders only. "Delivery" means orders with a delivery fulfillment type, and "counter" means in-store orders.

| | Delivery | Counter |
|---|---|---|
| Orders | 883 | 102 |
| Gross sales | $28,221.43 | $2,307.93 |
| Discounts | $1,264.85 | $110.62 |
| Total collected | $30,037.70 | $2,575.10 |
| Average order (gross) | $31.96 | $22.63 |
| Average tip | $5.05 | $3.25 |

Delivery brought in about 12 times the gross sales of the counter, on roughly 9 times as many orders. Delivery orders were also larger on average. The average tip only covers orders where a tip was recorded, because some channels don't pass tips through.

detail.purpose: Compare delivery vs in-store completed orders for Oct 12-18, 2026 (local time)
detail.sql: select fulfillment_type, count(*) orders, sum(gross_sales_cents) gross, sum(discount_cents) discounts, sum(total_cents) total, round(avg(gross_sales_cents)) avg_gross, round(avg(tip_cents)) avg_tip from orders where state='completed' and fulfillment_type in ('delivery','in_store') and (created_at at time zone (select timezone from merchants))>='2026-10-12' and (created_at at time zone (select timezone from merchants))<'2026-10-19' group by fulfillment_type

SELECT fulfillment_type, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(gross_sales_cents) AS gross, SUM(discount_cents) AS discounts, SUM(total_cents) AS total, ROUND(AVG(gross_sales_cents)) AS avg_gross, ROUND(AVG(tip_cents)) AS avg_tip FROM (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 1) AS orders WHERE state = 'completed' AND fulfillment_type IN ('delivery', 'in_store') AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM (SELECT * FROM merchants WHERE id = 1) AS merchants)) >= '2026-10-12' AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM (SELECT * FROM merchants WHERE id = 1) AS merchants)) < '2026-10-19' GROUP BY fulfillment_type LIMIT 500
